record.body:
## Rationale

A phase with a specification is structured work: specify, design, plan, execute, integrate when a wave is parallel, verify, assess, and release `ready` when every requirement is verified. Incidental work, and a phase with no specification, is simple work: execute, then verify as pass or fail. The simple path is the rule for that work, not a leftover for old stores. Forcing a typo through specification, design, and assessment would make the loop unused.

## Counter-argument

One path for every change would keep agents from skipping assess on work that later turns out to have a real requirement. The cost is a specification and an assessment for every incidental edit, including ones that fit in a single chat and have no acceptance records today.

payload.alternatives: Run every task through specify, design, plan, execute, integrate, verify, and assess.
payload.choice: Structured work (a phase with a specification) runs specify, design, plan, execute, integrate when parallel, verify, assess, and release ready. Simple work (incidental, or no specification) runs execute, then verify as pass or fail.

record.subject: two-modes
